pkgmetadata.longdescription: WolfCut (formerly Concat) is a free, open-source CapCut-style video editor: multi-track timelines, split/trim/merge, transitions, speed control, auto-captions, voice filters, and text overlays. It is a Tauri application whose Rust engine drives FFmpeg as external processes. This package installs the upstream prebuilt amd64 deb payload; it does not build the app from source. Transcription and text-to-speech run through the bundled whisper.cpp CLI and a statically linked sherpa-onnx runtime, with models downloaded on demand at first use.

use.flag: Drop the bundled nonfree FFmpeg build and run ffmpeg/ffprobe from media-video/ffmpeg found on PATH instead.
